electricityContract.terms: The full terms and conditions applicable to this offer are available at http://tangoenergy.com/terms-and-conditions. For further information about this offer, our terms or solar feed-in eligibility call Tango Energy on 1800 010 648.
electricityContract.variation: Prices are variable and may be varied by notice to you. We will provide you with information about any variations to your prices in accordance with Energy Laws. A network tariff code change may be required if you have a solar system installed.

eligibility.information: This offer is available to residential customers with a smart meter in Victoria on an applicable network tariff.
